name: Nullotitan
sum: Nullotitan is a lithostrotian titanosaur from the Chorrillo Formation of Santa Cruz, Argentina, a contemporary of the ornithopod Isasicursor.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: MACN-PV 18644; the site was reopened in 2019 and a new site found at Estancia La Anita.
material: Known from the holotype and further remains.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Novas et al. 2019
